description: Update policy shared by project-starter and every project made from it. Projects use it with `"extends": ["github>skyrix-lang/project-starter"]` in renovate.json.

packageRules.description: npm minor and patch updates in one pull request; each major gets its own, since it may need code changes.
All GitHub Actions in one pull request.
Postgres and Keycloak move together in docker/compose.yaml and the scripts that start them locally.
Node major versions are chosen on purpose (.nvmrc, Dockerfile), not bumped to the next odd-numbered, short-lived release.

customManagers.description: Container images started by the local scripts (scripts/db-up.sh, scripts/keycloak-up.sh).
